newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hallenstein same-store sales down in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Hallenstein same-store sales down in Dec.

text.p: New Zealand fashion retailer Hallenstein Glasson Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that group sales for December 1996 were 2.7 higher than a year earlier but fell 4.6 percent on a same store basis.

"Trading margin on December sales was below last year due to an extremely competitive apparel retail environment leading up to, and immediately after Christmas. Inventory levels are satisfactory and are expected to end the season similar to last year," the company said in a statement.
It reiterated that its result for the first half to February 1 would not match last year's, when it reported interim net profit of NZ$6.5 million.
